title: Historic Mansion For Sale: 16-room Victorian home hits market; five generations leave legacy
summary_full: Nestled in Parkersburg, West Virginia, a breathtaking 19th-century mansion known as Chancellor House is on the market. This remarkable estate has been cherished by the same family for five generations since its construction in 1878, showcasing the opulence of its original owner, William Nelson Chancellor. Spanning 5,827 square feet, it boasts 64 windows and intricate walnut woodwork, offering a unique opportunity to own a significant piece of local history.
